about: His standing on the street (scripts/street.gd): three numbers out of 100 and what moves them. Respect is what the block thinks he can and will do; heat is how hard the police are looking at him; trust is how far the block's ordinary people would stand by him. Each event names what changes: [flat, for each person who saw it]; "police" is added once for each officer who saw it. No more than `most` onlookers count. Every number here is a placeholder, written on 2026-11-15, not the owners'.

fair_one_won.about: beat a man who squared up to him, with hands, and walked away

fight_lost.about: put on the floor in a fight

stole_on_him.about: knocked down a man who was not looking, or would not fight

gun_on_hands.about: pulled a gun on a man who had squared up with his hands

sale_ready.about: a hand-to-hand sale of ready rock or dope

tape_sold.about: sold one of his own tapes

pack_paid.about: brought the front's money back on time

pack_late.about: a day late with the front's money

quiet_day.about: a day slept through at home: heat cools
